def pstate():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and 8 <= n['pixels'] <= 16:
            out.append((n['color'], tuple(n['boundary'][0]), tuple(n['boundary'][-1])))
    return out
print("start:", pstate())
for mv in ['UP','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT']:
    action([mv])
    print("after", mv, ":", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), pstate())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
